title: コインロッカー
description: 駅構内や観光地の通路に並ぶ、4列×5段・20口のコインロッカーです。台座と本体、上部のコーニス、高さの異なる扉と継ぎ目、ステンレスの錠ケースと鍵穴・硬貨投入口、無地の番号札を造形しています。番号・料金・注意書きなどの文字、扉の開閉、鍵や精算の機能は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.510 × 1.970 × 0.597 m、9,124三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A 4×5, twenty-door coin locker bank for stations and tourist walkways. It models the plinth and carcass, top cornice, doors of two heights with seams, stainless lock housings with key cylinders and coin slots, and blank number plates. Numbers, prices, notices and other lettering, door motion, keys and payment function are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.510 × 1.970 × 0.597 m; 9,124 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
